Invoice 465 is paid (P) and was entered first, so it is the copy to keep. Invoice 801 is the duplicate: it is open, has journal 2458, and should be voided. The reversal must reverse every line of journal 2458 in an open period (11 or 12). Journal 2458 has lines 5100 DR 12185.45 and 2000 CR 12185.45, so the reversal is 5100 CR 12185.45 and 2000 DR 12185.45, posted in period 11 (open).

Note that invoice 465's journal 1746 is the one that should remain, and nothing about it changes.
